national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Major Initiatives for Fast-Track Courts, Energy Storage, and Critical Minerals
bullets: Continuation of Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Fast Track Special Courts (including exclusive POCSO courts) approved for 5 years from April 1, 2026, with an outlay of Rs 3,788.04 crore funded partly from the Nirbhaya Fund.

Approved Rs 14,500 crore Viability Gap Funding (VGF) Scheme to develop 92 GWh of grid-scale energy storage capacity (60 GWh pumped hydro, 30 GWh battery energy storage, 2 GWh emerging technologies) by 2030-31.
Approved Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics & Research (VISTAR) to modernise India's statistical system using AI and technology.
Approved a scheme to strengthen domestic processing and capital subsidies for critical minerals like lithium, nickel, and cobalt to reduce import dependency.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Two-Year Extension for Agniveers Under Agnipath Scheme
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved a two-year extension for Agniveers, who were previously scheduled to exit after completing four years of service.
75 per cent of Agniveers who would have exited will now receive an additional two-year engagement period with higher remuneration, after which willing personnel can enroll in the Armed Forces.
The Agnipath scheme was originally introduced on June 14, 2022, with 25 per cent continuing into regular forces based on merit.

national_news.title: Indo-Pacific Regional Dialogue 2026 Focuses on Science and Technology Cooperation
bullets: The Indo-Pacific Regional Dialogue 2026 (IPRD-2026) commenced in New Delhi on November 3, organized by the Indian Navy in association with the National Maritime Foundation (NMF).
The theme for the three-day apex-level international strategic dialogue is 'Science, Technology and Academic Cooperation in the Indo-Pacific'.
Key discussions focused on academic networks, maritime situational awareness, protection of critical undersea infrastructure, and the Indo-Pacific Partnership for Maritime Domain Awareness (IPMDA).

national_news.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Addresses Delhi Defence Dialogue 2026
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the third edition of the Delhi Defence Dialogue at the Manohar Parrikar Institute for Defence Studies and Analyses (MP-IDSA) on November 3.
The theme of the dialogue was 'Defence Reforms, Aatmanirbharta, Collaborations and Exports', highlighting four interconnected dimensions for Viksit Bharat by 2047.

He emphasized that 'Aatmanirbharta' is a quest for technological sovereignty, noting initiatives like Defence Industrial Corridors and the corporatisation of the Ordnance Factory Board into seven DPSUs.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Pitches Rs 2.57 Lakh Crore Investment in Power Sector at Renewable Energy Summit
bullets: Bihar pitched investment opportunities worth Rs 2.57 lakh crore in its power sector at the India Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026 in New Delhi.
Under the Bihar Renewable Energy Policy 2025, the state has set a target to develop 24 GW of renewable energy capacity and 6 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2030.
The state's electricity demand has grown from 700 MW in 2005 to nearly 10,000 MW, with projections reaching 25,000 MW over the next decade.

bihar_news.title: Patna-Purnia Expressway Proposed as Bihar's First National Greenfield Expressway
bullets: The proposed Patna-Purnia Expressway (National Expressway-9) is planned as a six-lane greenfield corridor connecting central and northern Bihar.
The alignment is set to begin at Mirnagar in Vaishali and pass through Samastipur, Darbhanga, Saharsa, and Madhepura, ending in Purnia district.
Other major infrastructure projects slated for foundation laying include a proposed Central University near Vikramshila and an airport near Sultanganj in Bhagalpur.

bihar_news.title: Bihar becomes first state to introduce a comprehensive silt management policy
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister discussed the implementation of the state's pioneering silt management policy after a silt-removal agreement was signed with the Centre.
The policy aims to address recurring floods and utilize accumulated river silt for infrastructure development in the state.
Other discussed developments include industrial corridors like IMC Gaya and a major data centre inaugurated in Patna.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum in Patna secures ninth place globally and first in Asia
bullets: Bihar Museum in Patna has been ranked ninth worldwide and first in Asia in 'Worth a Journey's list of the world's 100 best museums.
Governor Syed Ata Hasnain congratulated the state Art and Culture Minister Pramod Kumar Chandravanshi and Museum Director Anjani Kumar for the achievement.
The announcement coincided with the launch of a cultural Bhojpuri Chhath song at the museum.

bihar_news.title: Revolt Motors Secures 1,100 BlazeX Electric Bikes Order from Bihar Police
bullets: Revolt Motors, a subsidiary of RattanIndia Enterprises, secured an institutional order to supply 1,100 BlazeX electric motorcycles to Bihar Police for patrolling purposes in Patna.
The contract delivery deadline is January 2027, but the company aims to complete deliveries ahead of schedule by November 2026.
The BlazeX electric bikes feature a range of up to 150 km, a removable battery, standard 10A socket charging, and built-in GPS tracking.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Deactivates Portals and Removes Striking Amins Amid Land Survey Backlog
bullets: The Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms Department ordered the immediate removal of striking land surveyors (amins) and deactivated their IDs on the e-Maapi portal.
District magistrates were directed to implement the replacement of striking personnel with special survey amins from block-level survey camps within 24 hours.
The action was taken to counter the rising backlog of land-survey and revenue-related public services caused by the ongoing agitation.
